Miramar Village is Bosa’s group of towers on Johnston Road and Thrift Avenue in White Rock’s Town Centre, built in stages from 2008, with shops and services at street level. The 17-storey tower at 1473 Johnston Road has 96 homes; the later towers at Thrift Avenue add 229 more.

Jared has listed and sold homes at Miramar Village, and has helped buyers purchase here. If you own here, he knows what buyers in this building pay for, and he can show you the recent sold prices before you decide. Call or text 604-928-1361.

Before you buy at Miramar Village

items.t: the Form B, two years of minutes, the bylaws, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show what Miramar Village owners are planning to fix and pay for.
since November 24, 2022, BC stratas cannot ban owners from renting, except in age-restricted buildings. Short-term rental limits can still apply.
pet limits, parking stalls, storage lockers and electric car charging are set by the bylaws and the title, home by home. Check them for the exact home you are buying.
